payload.claim: This comment above `started: set[str] = set()` says that, with `sleep` set, a raised `CellRuntimeError` is always taken back out of `started` (offered again). The diff makes this false: at line 325, a `CellRuntimeError` whose `raised_in_package` mark is set is explicitly excluded from `started.discard(...)`, so it is never offered again. The comment was not updated to say 'unmarked CellRuntimeError', so it now contradicts the exact mechanism this change introduces.
